KFBy Kristen French1:00 PM CST on November 13, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleOur oldest stories teach us that envy is an emotion to be feared. It can lead to moral bankruptcy, violence, the collapse of friendships, families, and kingdoms. It is the cause of the first murder on Earth described in the Bible and the Quran: Cain kills his brother Abel because he is favored by God, and is then filled with grief and guilt, cursed to wander the land forever restless and alone. Across the middle east, South Asia, and the Mediterranean, a tradition of believing that envious glances can bring tragedy leads some to wear amulets to ward off the so-called evil eye.Envy made the list of seven deadly sins for a reason.Read more: “Are Some People Addicted to Revenge?”Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
